title: The Midnight Crown Anew
author: Noor Ishikawa
blurb: Vesper Voss, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
